title: REQ · package.json declares phaser as an exact or tilde 3.90.x version
summary: The phaser dependency in game/frontend/package.json is 3.90.0 or ~3.90.0 and cannot resolve to 4.x.
description: Context: package.json currently has "phaser": "^4.2.1". Desired behavior: the declaration is changed to ~3.90.0 (or exact 3.90.0). Expected result: no caret range exists on phaser and the version is within 3.90.x. Why: lock the engine to the required Phaser 3.90 line.
acceptance_criteria: Given package.json, when dependencies.phaser is read, then it equals 3.90.0 or ~3.90.0 (matches /^~?3\.90\.\d+$/).
Given package.json, when dependencies.phaser is read, then it does not start with ^ and does not contain a 4 major version.
